description: Adds validated built-in blocks from Simulink/Simscape/Aerospace/Vehicle Dynamics/Powertrain Blocksets. Use when a standard library block exists for the component.

fields.description: Block instance name (e.g., 'FrontTire', 'BatteryPack'). Valid MATLAB identifier.
Full Simulink library path. Use findBlock() to discover. E.g., 'vdynblks/Tires/Tire (Magic Formula)' or 'simulink/Continuous/Transfer Fcn'
Struct of parameter name-value pairs. Field names MUST match block dialog parameter names exactly (case-sensitive). Use getBlockInfo() to discover valid parameter names.
Traceability mapping from paper params to block params. Each element: .source_param (paper name), .block_param (dialog name), .conversion (optional expression).
Input port signal names (for wiring documentation). Order matches block input ports.
Output port signal names. Order matches block output ports.
Target subsystem path. If provided, block is placed inside this subsystem.
Original equation from paper (for traceability report).
Classified model type (e.g., 'Pacejka Magic Formula', 'Second-order transfer function').
Why a built-in block was chosen over odeBuilder.
